name: 1D Box Smoothing
definition: A convolution kernel used to smooth data by replacing the value of a voxel with the average of neighboring voxels inside a box along the ray direction. It reduces noise in the final image.
summary: 1D Box Smoothing averages voxel values along the viewing ray using uniform weights to reduce noise in spectral data, distinct from 3D filters by restricting averaging to a single dimension.
